ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than US$5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide Licensee with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short insurance provision as new General Provision (l), because our playbook requires a vendor that operates the Platform and processes our order and trading data to carry CGL, E&O and cyber cover with certificates on request. We have dropped the post-termination coverage tail so the clause carries only the required limits; if the cyber limit is an issue we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision in General Provisions

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.

Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
